name: frozen-context-scheduler-rollout-v0.1

rollout_algorithm.name: one-step-policy-rollout-receding-horizon
rollout_algorithm.decision_rule: For every feasible next context action, compute immediate measured action cost plus the frozen base policy's expected remaining cost after each possible observation; choose the minimum expected total, execute exactly one action, observe, and replan.
rollout_algorithm.value_source: finite-world transition model in mechanics benchmark; real-agent implementation requires calibrated or sampled estimates

guardrail: No second-sealed-test seed, generator, OOD family, result, or coefficient may be added to this artifact after this freeze commit. Any sealed test must be implemented only in a later commit and must use new seeds and OOD families not used by the rollout development script.
claim_boundary: Synthetic controller mechanics only. This freeze does not establish natural-language routing accuracy or end-to-end LLM answer quality.
